properties.name: electrical_resistivity
properties.rule: Use grade- and temperature-specific source data for electrical design.

properties.name: temperature_coefficient_of_resistance
properties.rule: Populate from authoritative source before precision electrical/thermal coupling.

properties.name: thermal_electrical_coupling
properties.rule: Couple resistivity to temperature for electrothermal calculations.

engineering_rules: Magnesium is electrically conductive but generally has higher resistivity than copper and aluminium.
Electrical contact to dissimilar metals must also be considered as a galvanic-corrosion problem.
Contact resistance depends on surface condition, coatings, contact pressure and environment.
